diagram_previews.alt: Triangle ABC with AB = 5, BC = 6, CA = 7; the blue angle bisector AD and the red median AE meet BC at D and E; the incentre I on AD and the centroid G on AE lie on a short green segment parallel to BC; dashed segment BI.
